# Text preprocessing function
def preprocess_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = text.strip('"')
    text = text.replace("\\n", " ").replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\'", "'")
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]", " ", text)
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = text.lower()
    return text


# Extract text-based statistical features (ENHANCED with profane_direct_insult_count)
def extract_text_features(text):
    if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str):
        return [0] * 38

    original_text = text.strip('"') if isinstance(text, str) else ""
    char_length = len(original_text)
    words = original_text.split()
    word_count = len(words)
    punctuation_count = len(re.findall(r"[.,!?;:]", original_text))
    exclamation_count = original_text.count("!")
    question_count = original_text.count("?")

    alpha_chars = [c for c in original_text if c.isalpha()]
    capital_ratio = (
        sum(1 for c in alpha_chars if c.isupper()) / len(alpha_chars)
        if len(alpha_chars) > 0
        else 0
    )

    avg_word_length = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
    long_word_ratio = (
        sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
    )
    all_caps_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1)
    all_caps_ratio = all_caps_words_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
    repeated_punctuation = len(re.findall(r"[!?.]{2,}", original_text))

    words_with_repeats = sum(
        1 for w in words if re.search(r"(.)\1{1,}", w, re.IGNORECASE)
    )
    repeat_ratio = words_with_repeats / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
    short_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) <= 2)
    words_with_3plus_repeats = sum(
        1 for w in words if re.search(r"(.)\1{2,}", w, re.IGNORECASE)
    )
    words_with_4plus_repeats = sum(
        1 for w in words if re.search(r"(.)\1{3,}", w, re.IGNORECASE)
    )

    text_lower = original_text.lower()
    profanity_count = 0
    negative_word_count = 0
    positive_word_count = 0
    intensifier_count = 0
    second_person_count = 0
    question_second_person_count = 0
    profane_3plus_repeats = 0
    profane_4plus_repeats = 0
    profane_all_caps = 0
    profane_emphasized = 0
    intensifier_profanity_cooccur = 0
    direct_insult_pronoun_cooccur = 0
    negative_all_caps = 0
    negative_3plus_repeats = 0
    negative_4plus_repeats = 0
    profane_direct_insult_count = 0  # NEW FEATURE

    # URL and Email detection
    url_count = len(
        re.findall(
            r"http[s]?://\S+|www\.\S+|\S+\.(com|org|net|edu|gov|io|co)\S*",
            original_text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )
    )
    email_count = len(
        re.findall(
            r"\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b", original_text
        )
    )

    # Check for question mark + second-person pronoun co-occurrence
    question_segments = original_text.split("?")
    for segment in question_segments:
        segment_lower = segment.lower()
        segment_words = segment.split()
        for word in segment_words:
            word_clean = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z]", "", word).lower()
            if word_clean in SECOND_PERSON_PRONOUNS:
                question_second_person_count += 1

    # Track positions for proximity features
    profanity_indices = []
    profanity_word_indices = []
    intensifier_indices = []
    second_person_indices = []

    for idx, word in enumerate(words):
        word_clean = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z]", "", word).lower()
        word_original = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z]", "", word)

        is_profanity = word_clean in PROFANITY_WORDS
        is_all_caps = word_original.isupper() and len(word_original) > 1
        has_3plus_repeats = bool(re.search(r"(.)\1{2,}", word_clean, re.IGNORECASE))
        has_4plus_repeats = bool(re.search(r"(.)\1{3,}", word_clean, re.IGNORECASE))
        is_direct_insult = word_clean in DIRECT_INSULT_WORDS
        is_second_person = word_clean in SECOND_PERSON_PRONOUNS
        is_intensifier = word_clean in INTENSIFIER_WORDS
        is_negative = word_clean in NEGATIVE_WORDS

        # NEW FEATURE: Count words that are BOTH profane AND direct insults
        if word_clean in PROFANE_DIRECT_INSULT_WORDS:
            profane_direct_insult_count += 1

        if is_profanity:
            profanity_count += 1
            profanity_indices.append(idx)
            profanity_word_indices.append(idx)
            if has_3plus_repeats:
                profane_3plus_repeats += 1
            if has_4plus_repeats:
                profane_4plus_repeats += 1
            if is_all_caps:
                profane_all_caps += 1
            if is_all_caps and has_3plus_repeats:
                profane_emphasized += 1

        # Count negative sentiment words in ALL CAPS
        if is_negative and is_all_caps:
            negative_all_caps += 1

        # Count negative sentiment words with 3+ consecutive repeated characters
        if is_negative and has_3plus_repeats:
            negative_3plus_repeats += 1

        # Count negative sentiment words with 4+ consecutive repeated characters
        if is_negative and has_4plus_repeats:
            negative_4plus_repeats += 1

        if is_negative:
            negative_word_count += 1
        if word_clean in POSITIVE_WORDS:
            positive_word_count += 1
        if is_intensifier:
            intensifier_count += 1
            intensifier_indices.append(idx)
        if is_second_person:
            second_person_count += 1
            second_person_indices.append(idx)

        # Count direct insult words within 3 words of second-person pronouns
        if is_direct_insult:
            for sp_idx in second_person_indices:
                if abs(idx - sp_idx) <= 3:
                    direct_insult_pronoun_cooccur += 1
                    break

    # Count profanity words within 2 words of intensifier words
    for prof_idx in profanity_word_indices:
        for intens_idx in intensifier_indices:
            if abs(prof_idx - intens_idx) <= 2:
                intensifier_profanity_cooccur += 1
                break

    # Social media pattern detection
    mention_count = len(re.findall(r"@\w+", original_text))
    hashtag_count = len(re.findall(r"#\w+", original_text))

    # Calculate maximum consecutive profanity cluster size
    max_profanity_cluster = 0
    if len(profanity_indices) > 0:
        current_cluster = 1
        for i in range(1, len(profanity_indices)):
            if profanity_indices[i] == profanity_indices[i - 1] + 1:
                current_cluster += 1
                max_profanity_cluster = max(max_profanity_cluster, current_cluster)
            else:
                current_cluster = 1
        max_profanity_cluster = max(max_profanity_cluster, current_cluster)

    # Profanity ratio (profanity words / total words)
    profanity_ratio = profanity_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0

    # Profanity density per 100 characters
    profanity_per_100_chars = (
        (profanity_count / char_length * 100) if char_length > 0 else 0
    )

    # Negative sentiment ratio (negative words / total words)
    negative_sentiment_ratio = negative_word_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0

    # Positive sentiment ratio (positive words / total words)
    positive_sentiment_ratio = positive_word_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0

    # Negative to Positive sentiment ratio
    negative_to_positive_ratio = (
        negative_word_count / positive_word_count if positive_word_count > 0 else 0
    )

    # Maximum word repetition ratio (highest frequency of any word / total words)
    max_word_repeat_ratio = 0
    if word_count > 0:
        word_freq = Counter([w.lower() for w in words])
        max_freq = max(word_freq.values()) if word_freq else 0
        max_word_repeat_ratio = max_freq / word_count

    # Intensifier ratio
    intensifier_ratio = intensifier_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0

    # Second-person pronoun ratio
    second_person_ratio = second_person_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0

    # Question-second-person ratio
    question_second_person_ratio = (
        question_second_person_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
    )

    return [
        char_length,
        word_count,
        punctuation_count,
        exclamation_count,
        question_count,
        capital_ratio,
        avg_word_length,
        long_word_ratio,
        all_caps_words_count,
        all_caps_ratio,
        repeated_punctuation,
        repeat_ratio,
        short_words_count,
        words_with_3plus_repeats,
        words_with_4plus_repeats,
        profanity_count,
        profanity_ratio,
        max_word_repeat_ratio,
        negative_sentiment_ratio,
        profanity_per_100_chars,
        positive_sentiment_ratio,
        negative_to_positive_ratio,
        mention_count,
        hashtag_count,
        intensifier_count,
        second_person_count,
        question_second_person_count,
        profane_3plus_repeats,
        profane_4plus_repeats,
        url_count,
        email_count,
        profane_all_caps,
        profane_emphasized,
        max_profanity_cluster,
        intensifier_profanity_cooccur,
        direct_insult_pronoun_cooccur,
        negative_all_caps,
        negative_3plus_repeats,
        negative_4plus_repeats,
        profane_direct_insult_count,  # NEW FEATURE
    ]


# Apply preprocessing
train_df["Comment_clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["Comment_clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Extract text-based features
train_features = np.array(
    [extract_text_features(text) for text in train_df["Comment"].values]
)
test_features = np.array(
    [extract_text_features(text) for text in test_df["Comment"].values]
)

# Prepare features and target
X_text = train_df["Comment_clean"].values
y = train_df["Insult"].values

# Stratified train-validation split
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val, X_train_feat, X_val_feat = train_test_split(
    X_text, y, train_features, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Word-level TF-IDF Vectorization with stop word removal
word_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000,
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    stop_words=list(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS),
)

# Character-level TF-IDF Vectorization
char_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    max_features=10000,
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    stop_words=None,
)

X_train_word = word_tfidf.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val_word = word_tfidf.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_word = word_tfidf.transform(test_df["Comment_clean"].values)

X_train_char = char_tfidf.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val_char = char_tfidf.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_char = char_tfidf.transform(test_df["Comment_clean"].values)

# Convert text features to sparse matrices
X_train_feat_sparse = csr_matrix(X_train_feat)
X_val_feat_sparse = csr_matrix(X_val_feat)
X_test_feat_sparse = csr_matrix(test_features)

# Combine word, character, and text-based features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char, X_train_feat_sparse])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char, X_val_feat_sparse])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char, X_test_feat_sparse])

# Train Logistic Regression classifier
clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, C=1.0, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
clf.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Predict on validation set
val_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]

# Calculate AUC-ROC on validation set
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Make predictions on test set
test_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Create submission file matching sample_submission_null.csv structure
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": test_df["Comment"], "Date": test_df["Date"], "Insult": test_pred}
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
